title: One of the most pathetic experiences I have ever had with a financial platform.
raw_text:
Groww looks impressive until you actually need help. The moment there is a serious issue involving your money, the so-called “customer support” becomes an endless cycle of useless automated replies, copy-pasted messages and absolutely zero accountability.

It is honestly frustrating to see a financial platform put so much effort into making the app look smooth while seemingly putting so little effort into actually helping customers when something goes wrong.

You don’t feel like a customer—you feel like a ticket number being passed around by a system that doesn’t care whether your problem gets resolved or not.

When money is involved, “please wait” and generic replies are NOT customer service.

The entire experience has been unbelievably frustrating, time-consuming and disappointing. If you expect quick resolution, proper communication and someone to actually take ownership of your issue, don’t expect much from Groww.

I seriously regret choosing this platform. A financial service should give customers confidence and peace of mind—not make them constantly worry about whether their issue will ever be resolved.

Groww needs a reality check. A good-looking app cannot compensate for terrible support and a frustrating customer experience.

I would not recommend Groww based on my experience. There are better alternatives where customers deserve to be treated like customers.
author: Narayan_Awasthi
